name: Australia

nationalGame.name: Cricket
nationalGame.about: Summer means cricket in Australia — in backyards, on beaches and in giant stadiums.
nationalGame.note: Australia has no official national sport — cricket and Aussie rules football share the crown.

loved.name: Cricket
loved.why: The Ashes battle with England is over 140 years old.

loved.name: Rugby
loved.why: State vs state and country vs country — fierce and fast.

loved.name: Swimming
loved.why: Australians win Olympic swimming medals by the bucket load.

fact: The AFL grand final in Melbourne draws over 100,000 people — one of the biggest crowds in world sport.
